verdict_pack.headline: media: NOT REAL; caption claim: unverified
verdict_pack.reasoning:
Starting from the assumption the item is recycled: it holds up. The published fact-check archive WAS searched (status 'searched', one review returned), and the AFP entry is not a bare rating — the retrieved full text documents a concrete, item-specific contradiction. AFP quotes verbatim the exact caption under review, including the distinctive '50,000 feet' and 'Over 200 aircraft have been forced to divert' wording from the Chinese-language Threads post of 7 September 2026, and states the attached clip was uploaded to YouTube by a volcano photographer showing the same volcano erupting in October 2018. That is a documented incompatibility between the caption's date and the media's origin, not an inference from a headline. It is reinforced by an exact-match still on an ABC7 page dated 11 April 2020, six years before the claimed event. The date check independently lands on 2018-10 and is marked contradicted. So the recycling finding is solid on the media's date.

What is NOT solid is anything asserting the media is authentic footage of that volcano. The generated-or-manipulated test was never run, location was never pinned, and the source check found nobody to examine — so the desk is leaning entirely on AFP for the 2018 attribution and on nothing at all for geolocation. That caps how far the desk can go and should be carried as doubts, not treated as corroboration.

A second thing worth separating out: the underlying event is real. Anak Krakatau did erupt 4–5 September 2026, plumes did reach 50,000 ft (AP, quoting Lana Saria), Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta and up to seven other airports did close, and Level III was in force. The claim as worded — eruption caused Jakarta airport suspensions and diversions — is broadly true of the real event. What is false is that THIS footage shows it. The '200 aircraft diverted' number does not correspond to any figure in the official record, but the ministry published delay/cancellation totals rather than a diversion-only count, so that is an unpinnable caption number and belongs in doubts, not contradictions.

Nothing here is too good to be true in the fabrication sense; the pattern is the ordinary, high-frequency one of dramatic old eruption footage being reattached to a fresh, genuine disaster.

claim_finding.draft_enquiry: Dear Sir or Madam, I am checking a widely shared item of footage attributed to the Anak Krakatau eruption of 4-8 September 2026 and would be grateful for your help pinning down the accompanying claim. Could you confirm, first, the date and time of the specific eruptive event shown and whether the Geological Agency or PVMBG holds or has released imagery matching it; and second, which passenger and flight-disruption figures were current on each day, given that published totals moved from roughly 170,000 passengers and 1,558 flights on 6 September to about 341,000 passengers and 2,961 flights by 8 September? If the Ministry has issued any correction or clarification about figures or imagery circulating online, a pointer to that statement would be very helpful. Thank you for your time.

First, the exact caption wording under review, which is missing from this pack 
s- without it no assertion can be tested. Once supplied: if the claim concerns eruption timing, plume height or alert level, a statement or bulletin from Indonesia's Geological Agency/PVMBG (head Lana Saria) referring to that specific event; if it concerns flight, airport-closure or passenger figures, a dated statement from the Transport Ministry (Minister Dudy Purwagandhi) or InJourney Airports/Angkasa Pura specifying which day the number applies to; if it concerns casualties or damage, a BNPB figure. Absent one of those, the claim cannot be moved off unverified.

The record firmly establishes the underlying event: Anak Krakatau erupted from late 4-5 September 2026, sending plumes to 20,000 ft and 50,000 ft, closing up to eight airports including both Jakarta airports, with schools moved online and a 3 km exclusion zone at Alert Level III. Official impact figures escalated day by day 
s- 170,000 passengers/1,558 flights (6 Sep), more than 270,000/2,300 (7 Sep), about 341,000/2,961 including 622 international services (8 Sep) 
s- and airports reopened from 00:30 on 8 September. It does not address any particular caption's assertion about a specific clip, location, casualty count or cause, and it contains no denial of any such assertion.

Major airports in Jakarta have suspended flights. Over 200 aircraft have been forced to divert, with thousands of passengers stranded' — and ties it to a Chinese-language Threads post of September 7, 2026, establishing that the fact-check is item-specific rather than generic, and directly contradicting the 'erupted again this morning' framing of the attached media.

source_questions.draft_message: Hello, thank you for sharing this material regarding the eruption of Anak Krakatau and flight disruptions. We are looking into this event to accurately document what happened. Could you please tell us more about the footage or images you posted? Specifically, did you capture this media yourself or did someone share it with you? Where exactly were you when you recorded this or learned about it, and what was the date and time? blind_questions: Did you record or take this media yourself, or did you obtain it from someone else?
Where exactly were you located when this footage was captured or when you observed these events?
What exact date and time were you present or when was this material recorded?

How do you know that major airports in Jakarta suspended flights and diverted over 200 aircraft?
How else do you know that?
What device or camera equipment was used to capture this footage?
reflect_back_only_after_answers: Request original, uncompressed files directly from the capturing device to verify original capture metadata.
Request additional photos or video files captured immediately before and after this specific sequence from the same vantage point.
Probe any discrepancies regarding exact observation location, vantage point, and visibility line to Anak Krakatau.
Press for specific primary documentation or flight tracking sources supporting the exact claim of over 200 diverted aircraft.
Probe any timeline gaps between the stated time of eruption and the reported airport shutdown.

verdict_meanings.REAL: All four checks confirmed, the media tested clean for manipulation, any required specialist consulted, and nothing contradicts.
verdict_meanings.NOT REAL: Fabricated or manipulated media, or a caption whose claim is itself contradicted outright.
verdict_meanings.RECYCLED: An earlier copy of this same media exists that predates the claimed event: real footage of a real earlier event put under a new caption. RECYCLED does not assert the media is authentic to the claim, so it needs NO forensic test and NO specialist — the documented earlier copy is the evidence.
verdict_meanings.CANNOT TELL YET: Not enough confirmed, or REAL was blocked because a required specialist was never consulted or the media could not be tested for manipulation.
